custom_fields.description:
Adds a Scan CU Receipt button to draft Purchase Invoices that fills the Control Unit Invoice Number from the QR code on a KRA ETR / eTIMS receipt.

Ways to scan
• Phone: scan the code shown on screen, then the receipt; best for small (2 cm) or faint codes, with Take Photo for the hardest ones.
• Computer camera: hold the receipt up to the webcam, or upload a photo.
• Attachment: reads an attached PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP (HEIC only in Safari).
• Handheld scanner: click the field and scan; the KRA link is turned into the number.

Needs: the site opened over https for cameras, and internet access on the server for eTIMS receipts (the number is looked up on KRA's site).
custom_fields.label: Enable CU Invoice Number Scanning
custom_fields.name: Accounts Settings-custom_enable_cu_invoice_scanning
